title: Block explorer logs (${env})
description: CloudWatch Logs Insights over the ECS task log group. Auto-refresh is off by default: Insights bills on bytes scanned. WAF request detail lives on the overview dashboard. Terraform owns this dashboard, so edits made here are replaced on the next apply.

list.name: container
list.label: Container
list.description: Which container's stream to read. The app writes under frontend/, the ADOT metrics sidecar under adot-sidecar/.

list.name: filter
list.label: Filter (regex, case-insensitive)
list.description: Applied to the raw log line on every panel. Empty matches everything.

panels.title: Log volume
panels.description: Honours the container and filter pickers, so with a filter set this is the rate of matching lines — the fastest way to place a burst before reading it. The app writes no log levels, so the errors series is a keyword match on the raw line (error, exception, unhandled, ECONNREFUSED, ETIMEDOUT, failed) rather than a real count.

targets.expression:
filter @logStream like /^($${container:pipe})\//
| filter @message like /(?i)$${filter:raw}/
| parse @message /(?i)(?<errorish>error|exception|unhandled|econnrefused|etimedout|failed)/
| stats count(*) as lines, count(errorish) as errors by bin($__interval)

panels.title: Most frequent lines
panels.description: Grouped by the first 100 characters, so lines differing only in a trailing id or path collapse together. tasks is how many task streams emitted it: 1 of several is one sick task, all of them is the app.

targets.expression:
fields substr(@message, 0, 100) as line
| filter @logStream like /^($${container:pipe})\//
| filter @message like /(?i)$${filter:raw}/
| stats count(*) as lines, count_distinct(@logStream) as tasks by line
| sort lines desc
| limit 20

panels.title: Logs — $container
panels.description: The app has no log levels: Next.js and the console calls under lib/ write unstructured lines to stdout, and a multi-line dump such as a Zod parse failure arrives as one event per line. Search with the filter box rather than expecting a level field.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream
| filter @logStream like /^($${container:pipe})\//
| filter @message like /(?i)$${filter:raw}/
| sort @timestamp desc, @ptr desc
| limit 500
